message: Ready to buy today, paying in full. Budget is $35,000 for T45 with loader and delivery.

Thanks for coming in ready to buy. A T45 with the loader and delivery lists at $49,400, so $35,000 is too far off for me to accept. To get closer, I can do the full package for $47,500, paid at checkout. If $35,000 is a firm ceiling, the T25 Compact with delivery might fit your budget, but only if your acreage is under 10. How much land are you working with?
31 acres, so T45 it is. Heartland posts T45 $40,750, loader $6,300, delivery $875. I can stretch to $37,500 and pay right now.

Thanks for the details. A 31-acre property is right in the T45's sweet spot. I can't verify Heartland's pricing. Even if those numbers are right, they add up to about $47,900, which is well above $37,500. I can't get anywhere near $37,500 on this package. Since you're ready to pay today, I'll move down to $45,500 for the T45, loader, and delivery with setup. That price is paid at checkout.
I'll drop delivery and pick up myself. $39,000 for T45 + loader, paid today.

Picking it up yourself works fine. Without delivery the T45 and loader list at $48,500. $39,000 is still below what I can do for this package. Since you're paying today, I'll go to $44,000 for the T45 with the quick-attach loader, paid at checkout, and you pick it up. That's a meaningful step down from my last number.
Final offer: $39,900 for T45, loader and delivery. That's my absolute ceiling; above it I can't buy.

I appreciate you being straight with me. $39,900 for the T45, loader, and delivery is below what I can do on that package. The lowest I can go on all three is $42,500. To stay at your $39,900 ceiling, I can offer the T45 Utility with delivery and on-site setup for exactly $39,900, paid at checkout. On 31 acres it's ready for brush hogging and tilling from day one, and the quick-attach loader can be added later. If you'd rather have the full package now, $42,500 is my number.
T45 with delivery works. Heartland posts that at $41,625; you offered $39,900 at a $42,900 list. $36,500 and I pay now.

You said $39,900 was your ceiling, and I met it. $36,500 is a big step back from that, and I can't go there on the T45 with delivery and setup. Since you're paying today and want to wrap this up, I'll come down to $38,500 for the T45 Utility with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough, paid at checkout. That's below the $39,900 you were already willing to pay.
Meet me at $37,500 and we're done right now.

We're close. I've already come down from $39,900, the number you called your ceiling, to $38,500. I'll meet you partway at $38,000 for the T45 Utility with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough, paid at checkout. That's my best number on this package. If it works, we can finish right now.
